Ada Lovelace

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Ada Lovelace
Born10 December 1815
London, England
Known forMathematics

Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace (née Byron; 10 December 1815 – 27 November 1852) was an English mathematician and writer.[1] She is chiefly known for her work on the Analytical Engine.[citation needed]

Biography[edit]

Her notes contain what is considered the first algorithm, computing Bernoulli numbers Bn{\displaystyle B_{n}}.
